Online beauty and personal-care retailer in Uruguay on WooCommerce. Sells hair, hair removal, makeup, perfumes, lashes, skincare, nails and gift boxes. States it reaches anywhere in the country through Mirtrans and Agencia Central; Montevideo courier prices are listed by zone and interior costs are not.
